title: Kahana’s AI assistant is in beta
excerpt: A chatbot in the bottom-right corner, with a phoenix glowing around it. It can draft hubs, clubs, and affiliate links, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
defaultImageQuery: small warm lantern glowing in a dark library corner
metaDescription: How to open Kahana’s beta AI assistant, what the confirm cards do, and how to send feedback from the chat.
content:
The assistant is the chatbot in the bottom-right of Kahana, with a phoenix glowing around it. It is in beta. Try it, and tell us when an answer is off.

Open Kahana and look for that glow. You do not install a separate app.

Ask, or ask it to do the thing

“How do I list a hub?” gets steps. “Create a hub called Clear recipes” gets a card. The card is the part that can write. It stays a preview until you tap confirm.

The same pattern covers clubs, profile text, setup goals, and affiliate links for a hub you own. Uploads and cover photos need a file from the paperclip. Type @ when you mean a hub, club, or file you already have.

Train a good reply, or a bad one

Under an assistant message, thumbs up opens Train Kahana assistant on Good response. Thumbs down opens the same sheet on Bad response. Pick a category, mark what stood out, and write at least 30 characters about what worked or what should change next time. Choose Personalized or Anonymous, then submit. That trains this reply. It does not change a hub until you confirm a card.

The message icon in the header is still general feedback. The question mark is support, if you need a person. History keeps earlier threads.

Full guide: Kahana’s AI assistant.
